comment: dbt version testing matrix - defines which dbt versions to test with each adapter
version_pinning: All versions are EXACT patch pins, not minors. Runs stay reproducible.
Pins are bumped manually. Authoritative sources:
The Dockerfile pins dbt-core exactly and the adapter to the matching MINOR.
Adapter patch numbers are independent of core patch numbers. For example
dbt-core 1.11.11 exists but dbt-snowflake 1.11.11 does not.

coverage: Most adapters test only the newest version their adapter package supports,
to keep the suite affordable. Snowflake carries more cells because it is the
primary target and because the dbt v2 engines run against it.
postgres 1.11.14 - dbt-postgres tops out at 1.11.0, so 1.12.x is not testable.
sqlserver is NOT in the matrix. The package has no sqlserver__create_constraints
implementation and no default__, so the on-run-end hook fails at macro dispatch.
Add a cell back only after the package supports SQL Server.
Project choice follows the dbt version, not the adapter. dbt-core added the
`arguments:` test property in 1.10.5. Cells at 1.10.5 or later parse
conftest.py. Only the snowflake 1.5.12 cell parses the legacy project.
snowflake: 1.5.12 is the legacy floor, kept to catch backward-compatibility breaks.
This is the only cell that parses the dbt-legacy-syntax project. Keep it.
Newer dbt Core versions run in the dpos_core cell, inside Snowflake.
fusion: 2.0.8 is the newest Fusion GA release. On 2026-10-15 it is the newest 'dbt'
release on PyPI and the dbt Labs 'stable' and 'latest' channels.
The Snowflake-supported Fusion 2.0.0 runs in the dpos_fusion cell instead.
dpos: The dpos_core and dpos_fusion cells run dbt INSIDE Snowflake, through
dbt Projects on Snowflake. No dbt client runs on the host for these cells.
Version strings use the Snowflake form, not the PyPI form. For example
A GA version such as 2.0.0 has the same form in both.
2.0.0-preview.210, 2.0.0. The cells pin the newest of each engine.
dbt Core 2.0 betas are not a dbt Projects on Snowflake engine, so the
core2 cell cannot move and stays on the host.
core2: 2.0.0b2 is dbt Core 2.0, the Apache 2.0 foundation behind Fusion. It is NOT
Fusion: no SQL comprehension, no LSP, no dbt lint. Do not confuse it with the
'dbt' package, which installs Fusion. Always pin 'dbt': old 1.0.0.x releases
of that package are the dbt Cloud CLI, a different tool.

adapters.comment: Descriptive only. The test code reads dbt_versions and ignores this block.

dpos_core.comment: dbt Core inside Snowflake. Snowflake supplies the engine, so no package installs on the host. The host venv only runs dbt deps while staging the project.

dpos_fusion.comment: dbt Fusion inside Snowflake. Same as dpos_core: Snowflake supplies the engine.

fusion.comment: dbt Fusion - Rust engine. Adds SQL comprehension, LSP and dbt lint on top of dbt Core 2.0. Uses Snowflake credentials.

core2.comment: dbt Core 2.0 - the Apache 2.0 foundation behind Fusion. Not Fusion: no SQL comprehension, LSP or dbt lint. Uses Snowflake credentials.
